messages.subject: Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’
messages.subject_clean: Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I was trying to install the development version of ggplot2 and when i loaded the ggplot2 library, it says the file is corrupt and cannot be loaded.

library(ggplot2)

Error in get(method, envir = home) :
  lazy-load database '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/ggplot2/R/ggplot2.rdb' is corrupt
In addition: Warning message:
In get(method, envir = home) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘ggplot2’

Am i not supposed to use the development version yet?

Thanks
Upendra
